stages.text: Turn the spoiler setting on if you want the story trophies hidden until you earn them. Never use a cheat on your trophy save — cheats switch off trophies and saving. The game has no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so the saves you make are your only way back: keep one manual save at the start of every chapter and one untouched save from just before the final mission. There are 15 manual save slots plus one autosave.
stages.title: Before you start

stages.text: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing, then finish Chapter 1. Before the chapter ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation: after she is home, check the kitchen in the morning (a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time); she heads out to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate. Follow her and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude, the only trophy that can be missed. Keep a Chapter 1 save until that trophy pops.
stages.title: Chapter 1 — do the one missable thing

stages.text: Finish Breakfast Run to unlock switching between Jason and Lucia — that opens the partner trophies and most of the free-roam list. Do the time-sensitive Race Against Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3 (hourglass icon); its strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks. Buy the eight garages once the Vice City Real Estate app unlocks after Daily Driver, open the Scooter Bros app in the mission Moses, and start the side strands for Andy, Billy, Kenton, Randy and Tyrone.
stages.title: Chapters 2–3 — the world opens up

stages.text: The robbery tools arrive in the middle chapters: the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3), bank vaults from That's Where The Money Is near the end of Chapter 4. Rob a vault with your partner to earn Maximum Withdrawal and Hot Together in one escape. Before the final mission, make your untouched save — then finish the story.
stages.title: Chapter 4 and the finale — robberies and the last mission

stages.text: Everything outside the story stays open after the credits. The 100% checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 illegal operations. Finish the side-story finales, the collectible sets, the shooting ranges and the drone races, and Vice Got a Price! pops last.
stages.title: After the credits — cleanup to the platinum
